subject: LumenAI - Marketplace procurement & commercial path
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@lumenai.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@lumenai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: LumenAI - Marketplace procurement & commercial path

Hi Alex 

thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned:

- Summary: LumenAI is interested in Redwood for embeddings + chat LLMs to power in-app search and support routing. Primary constraint: procurement and billing model (PO vs card) and whether we can be purchased via AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace.

- Requirements you mentioned:
  - Need SOC 2 Type II report and data isolation clarifications for PII/log retention
  - Prefer invoice / PO billing for committed capacity; initial pilot may be on card
  - Marketplace would be preferred by procurement if available (AWS first)

- Action items / next steps:
  1) I will share our standard pricing + contract (attached) and a marketplace onboarding checklist.
  2) Marissa (cc) will surface SOC 2 and security artifacts to your security contact.
  3) Alex / procurement  


can you confirm whether LumenAI requires purchasing via AWS Marketplace (NET 30 PO to AWS) or if you can sign Redwood's PO invoicing directly? Also please confirm billing entity and legal contact for redlines.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-terms.pdf; marketplace-onboarding-checklist.xlsx

Proposed follow-up: 30-minute call next week to review contract path and timeline. My availability: Tue/Wed 10-12 PDT.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@lumenai.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@lumenai.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LumenAI - Marketplace procurement & commercial path

Thanks for the summary, Camila - this looks right. A few clarifications from our side:

- Procurement preference: LumenAI typically does PO invoicing (NET 30) for platform spend. For pilots under $5k we sometimes use corporate card, but for anything that becomes a committed seat/pool we need PO to our AP team.
- Marketplace: Procurement would prefer AWS Marketplace if Redwood is available there - it streamlines procurement and puts the billing on our existing cloud contract. GCP Marketplace is a secondary preference.
- Security: please send SOC 2 Type II and a list of where logs/PII are retained. Our security team will run a short questionnaire.

CC'd Procurement - can you confirm legal contact and any required PO language? Our legal is legal@lumenai.com.

Best,
Alex
Head of Product | LumenAI
alex.rivera@lumenai.com

From: Procurement Team <procurement@lumenai.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@lumenai.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LumenAI - Marketplace procurement & commercial path

Hi Camila / Alex - Procurement here. A few details from AP/legal: 

- We can process either (a) direct PO to Redwood (send invoice to LumenAI AP) or (b) purchase through AWS Marketplace. Our preference is AWS Marketplace for tooling reasons, but only if the SKU/pricing matches Redwood's public marketplace listing and if AWS can facilitate purchase orders.
- Required billing/legal contact for redlines: legal@lumenai.com
- PO timing: once contract and pricing are agreed, expect 7-10 business days for PO issuance for a new vendor (assuming no additional legal redlines).

Questions for Redwood:
1) Do you have an AWS Marketplace listing today? If not, what is the timeline to be published?
2) If we purchase via AWS Marketplace, will Redwood accept NET 30 invoicing or does purchase have to go through AWS billing terms (some customers require their own invoicing flow)?

Thanks - happy to hop on the call next week to align.

Procurement Team
LumenAI
procurement@lumenai.com
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@lumenai.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@lumenai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LumenAI - Marketplace procurement & commercial path

Thanks - this is helpful. Quick answers and proposed mutual action plan (MAP):

1) AWS Marketplace: Redwood is live on AWS Marketplace for a subset of offerings (verified listing for inference compute and select model bundles). We also support private offers through AWS if you need custom pricing. Marissa will share the marketplace onboarding checklist and the link to our listing.
2) Billing flows:
   - Direct PO to Redwood: we can accept NET 30 invoicing for committed reserved capacity contracts (we will generate invoices to your AP).
   - AWS Marketplace: purchases go through AWS billing; if you need Redwood to invoice LumenAI directly after purchase, we can evaluate private offer/contract setups but standard marketplace purchases will be billed by AWS.

Proposed MAP / timeline:
- Day 0-2: I will share the contract (DocuSign link) and pricing attachment (attached).
- Day 2-5: Your security/legal review SOC 2 artifacts (Marissa to send).
- Day 5-12: Procurement issues PO or completes AWS private-offer flow.

Attachments included: redwood-pricing-terms.pdf; marketplace-onboarding-checklist.xlsx
Related links: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/ (Marissa to provide direct SKU link)

Next step: I’ve scheduled a 30-minute call for Tue 17 Aug 2026 at 10:30 AM PDT to review the contract path and finalize whether we proceed with a direct PO or AWS private offer. If that time doesn't work, please propose alternatives.

Thanks - looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
